reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,470.0. That is 503.1 points below spot, 1.21 hourly ATRs on a 416.93 reading, and it sits beneath BOTH the 77,472.8 wick that already probed this zone and the 1H EMA20 at 77,547.16 / 1H EMA200 at 77,558.68 pair eleven points apart. addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 78,240.0 - unchanged from the midnight gate, deliberately. It clears the 78,176.1 twenty-four-hour high by a 0.15-ATR buffer of 63.9 points. Above it the realized-liquidation tape is nearly empty: 61,275 USD in the 78,250 bucket against 2,039,449 USD in the single 77,250 bucket below, so a settled break has very little resting flow to absorb it before the 4H twenty-bar high at 79,256.0. The gate has not fired in four hours forty-six minutes of trying; that is information, not a reason to lower it.

decisionBox.changed: The stance moves from ADD to a small REDUCE, and the bias from bullish to range-with-bullish-tilt, because the reclaim stopped paying. Price is 2.8 points higher than it was at 02:12 COT - flat over four hours forty-six minutes - while every momentum reading decayed underneath it. The 1H MACD histogram halved from +92.82 to +43.89, 1H RSI fell 58.25 to 54.86, the 15m histogram collapsed from +9.85 to +4.69, and the high since midnight was 78,058.9, a LOWER high than the 78,176.1 that printed during the midnight run. Three positioning readings turned the wrong way at the same time. Open interest ROSE 17,695,128 USD to 2,241,923,087 while price went nowhere, which is fresh leverage being added into a stall rather than the short covering that drove the overnight move. Funding rose from +0.0000501038 to +0.0000608482772682 for the 16:00 UTC settlement, so longs are paying more for a position that is not moving. And the liquidation tape went quiet: the last six hours ran 141,827 USD of long against 523,482 USD of short liquidations, down roughly 90 and 73 percent from the 1,523,272 / 1,928,612 USD the midnight report measured. The squeeze burned its fuel, exactly as midnight warned it would. What has NOT broken: price still holds above all four 15m EMAs, all four 1H EMAs and the 4H EMA20 at 77,764.18, the 4H histogram narrowed further from -46.43 to -18.13, and the daily trend is untouched at 3,321 points above the daily EMA20. So this is a stall inside an intact structure, not a reversal - which is why the action is a 5 percent spot trim and not an exit, and why futures stays flat rather than flipping short. The trim also does real work on the balance sheet: the wallet was 87 percent in BTC with 26.22 USDT of cash against a 30 USDT cost-of-living charge due 1 October.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull flips from UP at midnight to DOWN, and the reason is that the flow argument expired. Midnight called it up because the last six hours had run 1,928,612 USD of short liquidations against 1,523,272 USD of long - an active squeeze. That flow has collapsed to 523,482 and 141,827 USD over the most recent six hours, so what is left is mass, and mass is unambiguously below: 1,263,289 USD at 77,750 and 2,039,449 USD at 77,250 against 435,617 USD at 78,000 and 61,275 USD at 78,250. The honest counterweight is that a thin ceiling cuts both ways - there is almost nothing above to absorb a settled break of 78,240.0 either. And this feed is backward-looking; it records where forced flow HAS occurred, not where stops are resting now.
